basic_details.job_title: IIITM Gwalior Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 13 Junior Assistant, Junior Technician Posts
basic_details.short_information: ABV-IIITM Gwalior has 13 Group C vacancies through direct recruitment: 6 for Junior Assistant and 7 for Junior Technician. Graduates with knowledge of computer operation can apply for the first post, while Diploma or ITI holders with experience can apply for the second. Both posts have an upper age limit of 27 years. Applying takes two steps: an online application, followed by a signed print copy sent by post or courier.

The notice says the selection process will be notified later. It does set out these stages:
Meeting the minimum qualifications and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called. Shortlisting criteria may be higher than the minimum essential qualification as per RPN 2016
and the Institute may set higher norms to limit the number of candidates. The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the Institute website
and no individual communications will be sent. Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents with one set of self-attested copies at the selection process.
how_to_apply: Fill in the application on the ABV-IIITM online recruitment portal.
Pay the application fee and keep the proof and details of payment.
Sign each page of the system generated PDF version of the filled in application.
Put the application form and appendices in an envelope super-scribed "Application for the post of (name of applied post) in ABV-IIITM Gwalior".
Send it by post or courier to the Joint Registrar (A&A), ABV-IIITM, Morena Link Road, Gwalior- 474015, Madhya Pradesh.
Documents to send with the application:
Signed PDF version of the application and its appendices.
Proof and details of fee payment.

Reserved category candidates: category certificate in the prescribed Government of India format, issued by a competent authority not below the rank of a Tahsildar or by a first-class Magistrate of the place of domicile.
OBC and EWS candidates: Non-creamy layer OBC certificate (Govt. of India) or Income and Asset Certificate for EWS, as applicable.

Applications that are incomplete, not in the prescribed format, without supporting documents or fee, or received late will be rejected. The Institute is not responsible for any postal delay or loss of an application.

content_sections.heading: About ABV-IIITM
content_sections.text: ABV-IIITM, Gwalior is an Institute of National Importance set up by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Its objective is to impart education and conduct research in Information and Communication Technology and IT-enabled Management.

content_sections.heading: ABV-IIITM Junior Assistant and Junior Technician Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Reservation for differently abled (PwD) candidates applies as per the Govt. of India, but the notice prints no PwD break-up. Those claiming it need not less than 40% disability in the categories the notice lists, and must produce a medical certificate in the prescribed form from the competent medical authorities. content_sections.heading: ABV-IIITM Junior Assistant and Junior Technician Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for both posts is 27 years. Age, qualifications and experience are all considered as on 25 November 2026, the last date of application submission. Essential: Bachelor's degree with knowledge of computer operation. Desirable: 02 years' experience in Administration, Accounts and Audit, Academics or Store/Purchase in Centrally Funded Institutes, Central/State Govt., Semi Govt., Govt. Autonomous organizations, Govt. Universities or Institutions of Higher Education. OR a Diploma of Polytechnic in Modern Office Management with 01 year working experience of a Govt. organization. OR a Diploma of ITI in Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Stenographer and Secretarial Assistant, or Secretarial Practice with 02 years' working experience of a Govt. organization. Fluent Hindi and English typing, with knowledge of computer applications such as word processing, spreadsheets, presentations and recent apps. Excellent noting and drafting skills in Hindi and English. Essential: Either of the following: Diploma in CSE/ IT/ ECE/ EE, Instrumentation and relevant fields with 01 year working experience of a Govt. organization. ITI in relevant trades of CSE/ IT/ ECE/ EE/ Instrumentation with 02 years' experience. Desirable: 02 years' experience handling the lab of CSE/ IT/ ECE/ EE, Instrumentation in Centrally Funded Institutes, Central/State Govt., Semi Govt., Govt. Autonomous organizations, Govt. Universities or Institutions of Higher Education. OR B.Sc./BCA (IT/CS/Physics) with 02 years' hands-on experience of labs in the same types of organisations. Proficiency in computer operation or relevant lab software. Degrees must come from an Institute or University recognized by the Government or other Statutory Bodies. Experience should be in regular scale in a reputed organization. SC, ST, OBC, PwD, EWS and ESM candidates: as per Govt. of India norms. Regular, contract and outsourced employees working in ABV-IIITM Gwalior: the upper age limit is relaxed, without any other relaxations, as per approval of the BoG. Check the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply for both Junior Assistant and Junior Technician?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application is required for each post.

faq.question: Q2. Can an ITI holder apply for Junior Technician?
faq.answer: Yes. An ITI in a relevant trade of CSE, IT, ECE, EE or Instrumentation is accepted with 02 years' experience.

faq.question: Q3. I work in a government organisation. Must I submit an NOC with my application?
faq.answer: No, an NOC with the application is not mandatory, but you must submit an undertaking to that effect. You must then furnish the NOC at the time of the selection process, unless your application came through proper channel. Without either, you will not be allowed to attend. You may also send an advance copy within the stipulated time.

faq.question: Q4. How many candidates are called for Part-B?
faq.answer: Post-wise, 7 candidates for the first post and subsequently 5 candidates for the vacant post(s) are called for Part-B and the Skill/Trade Tests.

faq.question: Q5. How recent must my OBC or EWS certificate be?
faq.answer: The Non-creamy layer OBC certificate or the Income and Asset Certificate for EWS must be obtained on or after 1 April 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Can I send my application by email?
faq.answer: No. Applications sent through email will not be entertained and will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q7. What happens if the last date falls on a holiday?
faq.answer: If the last date fixed for receipt of applications is declared a holiday, the next working day is treated as the last date for receiving applications.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need a personal email address and mobile number?
faq.answer: Yes. You need at least one email id and mobile number that can be used for communication during the entire selection process.
